user.title: Clean Energy
user.description: Monitors energy sensors for anomalous spikes and corrects long-term statistics. Set the maximum realistic power draw for any single sensor. After install, additional sensors are added automatically when a spike is detected, or manually via the `clean_energy.monitor_sensor` service.

confirm.title: Spike detected: {name}
confirm.description:
A suspicious spike was detected on **{entity_id}**: {spike_from} → {spike_to} {spike_unit} (implied {implied_power_kw} kW).

Would you like Clean Energy to automatically correct future spikes on this sensor?

abort.already_configured: Clean Energy is already set up
abort.not_energy_sensor: This entity is not a total_increasing energy sensor

error.not_energy_sensor: This entity is not a total_increasing energy sensor

sensor.title: Repair Clean sensor
sensor.description: Adjust the offset (in the source sensor's unit) that the Clean entity for **{entity_id}** subtracts from the source. If the spike was missed at discovery time and the Clean sensor is currently mirroring the bogus value, set this to (current_source_reading − last_known_good_reading) and save.

monitor_sensor.name: Monitor sensor
monitor_sensor.description: Manually start monitoring an energy sensor for spike correction, without waiting for the passive watcher to detect a spike.

entity_id.name: Energy sensor
entity_id.description: The total_increasing energy sensor to start monitoring.
